text:
sam: Quick check - ran a preview for a feature-flag rollout that shifts 20% of /chat traffic to new model variant. Console quick estimate says +11% cost but staging replay shows +0.9%.
elaine: Sounds like the cheap estimator again. It doesn't simulate KV cache hits or request coalescing.
peter: We have two codepaths: quick_est (used by console inline) and replay_est (used by offline replay). Console should show both and label them.
ux-maya: UX: show "Quick (fast)" and "Replay (accurate)" numbers side-by-side, with a tooltip "Quick ignores batching & cache -> can overstate cost for concurrent workloads". Show spinner for replay.
qa-ivy: Also noticed preview didn't warn on per-model quota. Some tenants would drop below safe headroom after this rollout. The preview only shows account-level quota.
elaine: We can include per-route and per-model headroom fields in preview response. If headroom <10% add risk: "high" and suggested mitigations.
sam: API idea: /v1/preview now returns {preview_job_id, quick_estimate, replay_status_url}. Server enqueues replay_est and posts final result to /v1/preview/{id}/status when done. Include replay_trace_id, ci, cohort_hash_version, and per-model headroom.
peter: Make preview_job_id deterministic so replay can pick the same trace window. Replay should run the same cohort hashing as the rollout to get matching cohort assignments.
ux-maya: For promote/dry-run, return telemetry_recommendations array with things like {metric, from, to, duration, cli}. Console will render these in a collapsible "Ops guidance" card with copy buttons.
elaine: Also include recommended alert sensitivity changes when risk is high, e.g., "lower model-quota alert threshold by 15% for 20m".
qa-ivy: For safety, add an apply-sampling endpoint: POST /v1/ops/temporary-sampling that applies the suggested sampling override and emits an audit event with user and preview_job_id.
infra-bot: preview-bot: queued replay job 1797500000; ETA ~18s.
sam: Thanks — action items: peter implement preview_job_id lifecycle + deterministic trace window; elaine add per-model headroom + risk tags + telemetry_recs; ux-maya mock UI; qa-ivy implement apply-sampling + audit.
infra-bot: preview-bot: job 1797500000 completed. final_estimate: +0.9% (ci -0.6..+2.3). replay_trace_id=rt-2026-11-26-17975.
